subject: Quick follow-up: confirm 30-minute product brief & ops contact
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: confirm 30-minute product brief & ops contact

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today — good to hear more about NovaCorp's ingestion pipeline and the token-cost constraints you have on high-throughput endpoints. Quick recap and the ask:

Recap (2 bullets):
- Primary goal: reduce per-request inference cost while keeping median tail latency under 200ms for short queries (~64 tokens).
- Key stakeholders: Data Platform (you/ Priya), Security (secops), and an engineering owner who will validate the integration (ops contact).

Next step: a short, targeted 30-minute product brief where we can demo the runtime, show a quick cost/latency dashboard, and answer any engineering/security questions. Proposed agenda:
- 15m: product walkthrough (live request + batching demo)
- 10m: technical Q&A (KV cache, quantization profiles, rollout controls)
- 5m: next steps & mutual action items

I can do any of the following windows (Pacific time):
- Wed Jun 21 — 9:30–10:00am PT
- Thu Jun 22 — 11:00–11:30am PT
- Fri Jun 23 — 2:00–2:30pm PT

Could you confirm which slot works best and who from your side should join (engineering/ops + security)? If it's easier, here's a one-click booking link: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-product-brief?cid=deal-2028-0449

I've attached a short discovery notes PDF and a one-pager we usually share ahead of these briefs — you can pass them to Priya or the secops team if helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
—
Attachments: 20280620-discovery-notes.pdf (text), redwood-quick-brief.pdf (text)

Diego —

Appreciate the recap. Thu Jun 22 11:00–11:30am PT works for us. Please include Priya (data platform) and I'm looping our security alias so they can chime in on any compliance questions — they may not attend but good to have them in the thread.

For the agenda, can we make the Q&A 15 minutes and shorten the demo to 10? Our tech lead wants more time to dig into batching/kv cache behavior.

Also: our integration owner will be Sara (sara.haynes@novacorp.com) — she's the person who will set up the test environment and validate end-to-end behavior. Can you add her to the invite?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Data Platform | NovaCorp
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prep for NovaCorp 30-min brief (Thu 11:00 PT)

Marissa / Neha —

Heads-up: NovaCorp confirmed Thu Jun 22, 11:00–11:30am PT (Alex, Priya, Sara H., secops). We need someone to lead the demo and someone to own the deeper technical Q&A. Can you take these on?

Suggested split:
- Neha: lead technical Q&A (15m) — focus on batching patterns, KV cache TTLs, quantized model fit for short-context production requests. Please prepare a short slide with the KV cache behavior + one live request showing cache reuse.
- Marissa: run the 10m product walkthrough and handle next steps / mutual action plan.

Prep items (actionable):
- Neha: bring the local demo that uses the 64-token sample request we discussed in discovery; note any config knobs and expected unit-cost delta.
- Marissa: prepare a tailored mutual action plan doc (1 page) we can share as the outcome.
- Diego: I'll add Sara to the invite and send the calendar link once Neha confirms availability.

Can you confirm by EOD today? Also flag if you need a staging key or short demo config from infra — I can loop EngOps.

Thanks — Diego
